title: Digging for Gold
description: A view of an active open-cut gold mine in Western Australia. These mines, which extract minerals from the surface of a hole or pit in the ground, operate in remote areas hundreds of miles from city centers. Scott McCook is drawn to photographing these sites from above, offering a view of a world average Australians will never see. To him, such images reveal "what exists beyond the horizon and allows [people] to explore the details and environmental effects for themselves," he writes on social media.
translated_description: 西澳大利亚一座正在运营的露天金矿的景观。这类矿山通过在地面坑洞或矿坑表面开采矿物，其作业区域位于距市中心数百英里外的偏远地带。斯科特·麦库克热衷于从高空拍摄这些场地，呈现普通澳大利亚人永远无法目睹的世界。他在社交媒体上写道，对他而言，这些影像揭示了"地平线之外的景象，让（人们）自行探索其中的细节与环境影响"。
